content: {"reasoning":"The payer accepts the diagnosis pairing and prior auth isn't required, so the only obstacle is the CO-97 bundling denial claiming the service isn't separately payable. Retro-auth is irrelevant (not required, window not offered), and resubmitting as-is or with records won't overturn a bundling determination. A formal appeal arguing the service was separately performed and medically necessary is the correct path, and a valid denial (CO-97) is on the table to support it.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
